# AU Corporate

> AU Corporate is a business advisory and accounting firm based in New Delhi, India, founded in 2016. It helps foreign companies enter, incorporate, and operate in India — company formation, FEMA/RBI and tax compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, and related regulatory advisory.

Primary services: India market entry and Global Capability Center (GCC) advisory, assurance and accounting (IFRS/Ind AS), taxation and transfer pricing, FEMA and RBI regulatory compliance, accounting and payroll outsourcing, Virtual CFO services, HR outsourcing, risk and transaction advisory, business valuation, and arbitration/dispute resolution.

Contact: partner@theaucorp.com | +91-9999010513 | New Delhi, India

Full page index (every page on the site, not just the curated list below): https://www.theaucorp.com/llms-full.txt

## USA → India — Complete Guide

AU Corporate's most developed country-entry guide, with a dedicated sub-page for most steps of the subsidiary lifecycle, and a 216-question FAQ:

- [Set Up a Subsidiary in India from the USA](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india): Overview — structure, FDI rules, incorporation steps, RBI/FEMA filings, tax and compliance
- [Incorporation Process](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/incorporation-process): The eight steps to incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary, forms and typical 4-6 week timeline
- [Subsidiary vs Branch vs Liaison Office vs LLP](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/subsidiary-vs-branch-vs-liaison-office-vs-llp): Compare the four ways a US company can enter India
- [Documents and Apostille](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/documents-and-apostille): Which documents a US parent must prepare, notarization and apostille for US state/federal documents
- [Resident Director Requirement](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/resident-director): Who qualifies, options for US parents, and duties
- [Funding and Form FC-GPR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/funding-fema-fc-gpr): Equity, CCPS, ECB, the 60-day allotment rule, pricing, and RBI reporting
- [Share Valuation](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/share-valuation): Why shares issued to a US parent need a valuation, who can certify it, FEMA pricing floor
- [Repatriating Profits](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/repatriating-profits): Dividends, service fees, royalties, loans, withholding tax and DTAA relief
- [EOR vs Subsidiary](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/eor-vs-subsidiary): Speed, control, compliance, tax presence and when to convert
- [Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/transfer-pricing): Arm's length pricing, documentation, methods, safe harbour and audits
- [India-US Tax Treaty and PE Risk](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/dtaa-pe-risk): Withholding tax rates, Tax Residency Certificate, permanent establishment risk
- [US Parent Reporting Obligations](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/us-parent-obligations): Form 5471, FBAR, Form 8938 and other US-side reporting
- [Compliance Calendar for US Companies](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/compliance-calendar): Monthly, quarterly, annual and event-based filings
- [Audit and ICOFR](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/audit-icofr): Statutory audit, tax audit, GST audit and internal controls
- [Tax Notices and Litigation](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/tax-notices-and-litigation): First steps, appeal routes, DRP, ITAT, MAP and Advance Pricing Agreements
- [Contracts and Arbitration](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/contracts-and-arbitration): Intercompany and customer contracts, governing law, arbitration clauses
- [ESOPs for Indian Employees](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/esop): FEMA reporting, employee tax, valuation, cost recharge and transfer pricing
- [Restructuring, Mergers and Exit](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/restructuring-and-exit): Share sale, slump sale, merger, buyback, strike-off and liquidation
- [Sending a US Executive to India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/expat-visa): Employment visa, FRRO registration, housing, banking, tax residency
- [Global VAT for US Companies Selling Abroad](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/global-vat): VAT registration, B2B/B2C rules across the US, EU, UK, Japan and more
- [Hiring in India](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/hiring-and-payroll): Employment contracts, provident fund, ESI, gratuity, labour codes
- [10 Common Mistakes](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/common-mistakes): The most common and costly mistakes, with a pre-filing checklist
- [216 FAQs on India Entry from the USA](https://www.theaucorp.com/blog/usa-to-india/faq): Plain answers on incorporation, FEMA, tax, hiring, compliance, repatriation, ESOPs, M&A and closing an Indian subsidiary

Note: dedicated guides for other countries (UK, Singapore, Australia, Germany, Japan, China) are in development and not yet published.

- [India Subsidiary Registration](https://www.theaucorp.com/india-subsidiary-registration): Incorporation, PAN, TAN, bank account, share issue and FC-GPR
  - [Accounting & Audit Support](https://www.theaucorp.com/accounting-reporting-audit-support), [FEMA & RBI Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/fema-rbi-compliance), [Corporate Tax, GST & Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/corporate-tax-gst-transfer-pricing), [Secretarial & ROC Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/secretarial-roc-compliance), [Payroll & Expat Services](https://www.theaucorp.com/payroll-expat-services)
- [Branch Office Registration](https://www.theaucorp.com/branch-office-registration): Form FNC, RBI/AD bank approval, UIN, ROC Form FC-1, PAN and TAN
  - [FEMA & RBI Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/branch-office-fema-rbi-compliance), [ROC Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/foreign-company-roc-compliance), [Tax, GST & Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/branch-office-tax-gst-transfer-pricing), [Accounting & Audit Support](https://www.theaucorp.com/branch-office-accounting-audit), [Payroll & FRRO](https://www.theaucorp.com/branch-office-payroll-compliance)
- [Liaison Office Registration](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-registration): Eligibility, Form FNC, UIN, ROC Form FC-1, PAN, TAN and permitted tasks
  - [FEMA & RBI Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-fema-rbi-compliance), [ROC Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-roc-compliance), [Tax Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-tax-compliance), [Accounting & Audit Support](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-accounting-audit), [Payroll & FRRO](https://www.theaucorp.com/liaison-office-payroll-compliance)
- [Project Office Registration](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-registration): General permission under Regulation 5, Form FNC-1, ROC Form FC-1, PAN and TAN
  - [FEMA & RBI Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-fema-rbi-compliance), [ROC Compliance](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-roc-compliance), [Tax, GST & Transfer Pricing](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-tax-gst-transfer-pricing), [Accounting & Audit Support](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-accounting-audit), [Payroll & FRRO](https://www.theaucorp.com/project-office-payroll-compliance)
